feeds.title: TidyMom
feeds.description: TidyMom is a place for easy recipes, household tips, crafts, and products that help ease the chaos of everyday life. Cheryl is a self-proclaimed neat-freak, mom, and wife, whose passion is baking, creating, photography, travel, and of course, family.

feeds.title: Guide For Geek Moms
feeds.description: Great low calorie recipes, exercise advice and funny stories! Mom of two young kids, on a mission, to beat the battle of the bulge. Love to travel, cook, eat chocolate, binge-watch movies, celebrity scout, ride roller coasters & annoy my kids.

feeds.title: Bev Cooks
feeds.description: Bev Weidner is a food blogger, an obsessed photo-taker of her twins, a wifester, a cheese lover, a musician, a runner, knows every word and lyric to the sound of music, and a continual changer of hair. She fell in love with the art and process of blogging; cooking, photographing and sharing the experience. You'll find a mix of recipes, a splattering of DIY projects, and the worst parenting advice.

feeds.title: Rural Missouri
feeds.description: Devoted to the rural way of life. Each month, Rural Missouri brings you entertaining and informative features on some of the Show-Me States most fascinating people and businesses. We highlight Missouri's delicious dining destinations and road-trip worthy getaways. Our Neighbors section highlights the one-of-a-kind characters that make Missouri so unique.

feeds.title: Missouri Magazine
feeds.description: Missouri Magazine is a digital magazine that covers all things Missouri. They have articles on food, travel, health, fashion, and more. They also have a section on Missouri's best businesses, restaurants, and events.

feeds.title: The Bandit Lifestyle
feeds.description: A popular Missouri & Iowa lifestyle blog featuring favorite products, travel, entertainment, food, and more near the Kansas City area.

feeds.title: Nifty Mom
feeds.description: Samantha is a lifestyle parenting blogger and self-proclaimed chaos coordinator from the St. Louis area. Her passion for blogging has grown to a great love for social media, photography, and amazing communities.

feeds.title: Faith Health & Home
feeds.description: I am Makeba Giles, Digital Content Producer, Influencer, and Founder of Faith Health and Home. It is a digital space that shares advice, topics, information, and resources to inspire and empower women and families around the globe.

feeds.title: Travel in Missouri
feeds.description: We are Alexa and Todd, the creators, writers, and photographers behind Travel in Missouri. This is a Missouri travel blog that features travel tips, travel advice, travel inspiration, historic hotel, and unique accommodation reviews to help plan your next Missouri vacation.

feeds.title: Missouri Girl Home
feeds.description: Creating a beautiful and tasty home on a budget. Missouri Girl Home is a lifestyle blog featuring delicious recipes, easy diy ideas of the home, gardening hacks, creative holiday ideas throughout the year, as well as home tips and tricks to make life easier.

feeds.title: Emmy Lou Styles
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Emily; wife, mom of two, and all things digital freelance entrepreneur! This is a space where I share my love of all things style, home, family, DIY and more here in Saint Louis, MO.

feeds.title: And Hattie Makes Three
feeds.description: And Hattie Makes Three is a Lifestyle and Motherhood Blog focused on Family, Food, Fashion and St. Louis.

feeds.title: Joplin MO Life
feeds.description: A blog that offers firsthand accounts of experiences at area attractions, so you'll know where to go and what to do in southwest Missouri. Check out the area events calendar, the interactive map, reviews about businesses, restaurants, and services, plus lifestyle articles and recipes.

feeds.title: This Kansas City Mama
feeds.description: I'm Andrea of This Kansas City Mama! I'm a mama, wife, blogger, DIY enthusiast, a self-professed fashionista, and mompreneur. On this blog I am sharing all of my favorite things from fashion to home decor, places to explore around Kansas City, and so much more.

feeds.title: Modern Missouri Pioneers
feeds.description: Modern Missouri Pioneers provides information to enhance and encourage a back-to-basics lifestyle in our modern world. Follow to know more about us and bring back the ways of yesterday into the lives of today.

feeds.title: Living Chic Mom
feeds.description: Welcome to LivingChicMom.com!!! I am Angelique Campbell. I am a mommy of 4 kids and a wife to an amazing husband! Come join me in the adventure of saving money and maintaining life on a budget. live, craft and cook on a budget.

feeds.title: Missouri Life
feeds.description: Missouri Life is the state's premier culture and lifestyle magazine, featuring unique Missouri people, places, food, music, art, made-in-Missouri products, and more. Missouri Life Magazine strives to surprise and delight readers with insightful stories, dramatic design, and bold photography.

feeds.title: Britt's Space
feeds.description: I am Brittany. I'm a mama to three littles, digital content creator, and mom blogger! I wanted a space to share life, motherhood, struggles, fashion, cooking, thoughts, and everything in between.
